mission: C1-Validation + Zero-Cost Capability Ceiling Investigation, Phase 2
scope_note: Scores this system as-is: current hardware (Apple M5, 10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 24GB unified memory), current Ollama models, current code. No money spent, no fine-tuning, no P1/P1.2/Learning-Pilot/P2/P3 evidence modified. Scale is 0-7: 0=absent/fiction, 1=claimed/conceptual only, 2=implemented but hollow/dead, 3=causal pathway exists but unverified live, 4=experimentally demonstrated (narrow/small-N), 5=robustly demonstrated (repeated, ground-truth checked), 6=generalized (works on varied unseen inputs), 7=autonomous+generalized+robust.
evidence_sources: CLAUDE.md Findings 1-85 (this project's own running audit log)
live liveness-status endpoint read this session (51/51 checks passing, not stale)
live RiverBrain model_task_stats unpickled this session
live hardware inspection this session (sysctl, system_profiler, df, ollama show/ps)
audits/c1_live_validation_report.md (produced this session, Phase 1 of this mission)

Explore-agent-summarized readings of: echo_learning_causal_autopsy.md (P2), p3_persistent_behavioral_learning_spec.md (P3), echo_preference_formation_retention_experiment.md (P1 design), P1.2_live_validation_report.md, 2026-09-03_measurability_and_longitudinal_evidence_audit.md, 2026-09-02_gap_analysis_and_next_investigations.md, 2026-09-03_self_modification_evidence_index.md

dimensions.name: reasoning
dimensions.evidence: RiverBrain's own 'reasoning' task-type bucket has only 5-112 real observations per model (vs 8,724-48,829 for coding, 43,216 for personal) -- this capability is real but drastically under-exercised in real production traffic. Council deliberation + synthesis genuinely combines multiple models' outputs (river_deliberation.py, Phase 10 logging confirms distinct raw per-councillor text).
dimensions.causal_pathway: prompt -> task_type_classifier -> council selection (RiverBrain score) -> per-model generation -> synthesis -> response
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: Finding 54's real multi-councillor technical-reasoning exchange completed with zero truncation and full, coherent per-model answers (verified against raw council_deliberations.jsonl, not just the client stream).
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: Finding 43: given the exact task self-edit's own pipeline fails at (a targeted code-generation problem), a clean direct conversational ask also produced confidently-explained, non-functional code, and one raw councillor response fabricated a specific 'verified' output that is false when actually run.
dimensions.bottleneck: model size (all local models are 3B-8B class; no larger reasoning-tuned model is present) and sparse real-world sampling of this exact task_type bucket
dimensions.limitation_type: hardware-and-model-ceiling, not architectural
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: route more real 'reasoning'-tagged traffic through the existing pipeline to build a real evaluation sample; no code change required to test this
dimensions.risk_confounds: small N makes any measured rate unstable; council synthesis can mask an individual model's error by blending it with better answers, inflating apparent quality

dimensions.name: memory_retrieval_l1
dimensions.evidence: 123,574+ vector entries live (memory_meta.json), 48.7% of which were once code_analysis contamination -- now fixed and excluded from both the dream-sampling path (_load_waking_memories) and the conversational retrieval path (retrieve_relevant_memories), confirmed live and passing (code_analysis_retrieval_exclusion, awareness_scan_hygiene checks both pass, 2026-09-03).
dimensions.causal_pathway: conversation -> add_to_vector_memory() -> FAISS index -> later prompt -> retrieve_relevant_memories() -> context injection -> generation
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: The write and read paths are both real, live, and correctly gated (memory_write_validator, exclusion filters) -- this is the most robustly-verified subsystem in the whole codebase by evidence volume.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: Finding 76's real ablation experiment (30 real prompts, real vs. retrieval-disabled) found the embedding-distance effect of removing retrieval was statistically indistinguishable from ordinary sampling noise (p=0.48/0.37) on the personal-task path specifically -- meaning retrieval demonstrably WRITES and IS QUERIED, but its measured behavioral effect on the one task type actually tested was not distinguishable from zero. The 2026-09-02 gap analysis names this as still unresolved for the majority of traffic (non-personal task types), with only n=1 tested there.
dimensions.bottleneck: no experiment has yet isolated retrieval's causal effect at temperature=0 or on non-personal task types
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement gap, not an infrastructure gap
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: rerun Finding 76's ablation at temperature=0 across all five task types (proposed in that audit's own §5, never executed)
dimensions.risk_confounds: a null result at temp=0 would be a much stronger claim than the current noisy-sampling null; conversely a real effect could still be hiding under sampling noise today

dimensions.name: cross_session_continuity_infrastructure
dimensions.evidence: This session's own live C1 validation: state_existence, state_retrieval, and directive_exposure were all correctly True/False across all 9 measured trials (2 baseline, 2 immediate, 2 restart-simulated, 2 control, 1 near-miss), with zero false positives or negatives, using genuinely separate subprocesses (stronger than in-process restart simulation).
dimensions.confidence: high, but n is small (9 trials, one mechanism)
dimensions.causal_pathway: human_confirmed directive -> atomic JSON write -> disk -> fresh process load_state() -> deterministic keyword match -> echo_ground_truth.py slice -> system prompt
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: 100% architectural reliability across every trial in this session's live test -- see audits/c1_live_validation_report.md.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: Only one mechanism (behavioral_state.py/C1) has been live-validated this way; echo_state.npy's 9D vector and salience_state.json also persist across restart but were not live-behaviorally-validated in this same rigorous way this session.
dimensions.bottleneck: breadth -- only one persistence channel has been rigorously live-tested end-to-end
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement-coverage gap, not architectural
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: repeat this session's exact A-F design against echo_state.py/valence and salience_state.json's own claimed downstream effects
dimensions.risk_confounds: none identified beyond ordinary small-N variance

dimensions.name: learning_l2_autonomous
dimensions.evidence: P2 causal autopsy (echo_learning_causal_autopsy.md, re-verified 2026-09-03): only RiverBrain.learn() is live and causally connected to anything, and it only affects MODEL SELECTION (model_task_stats -> score_model() -> _select_council()), never response content. learn_from_council_rating() -- previously reported working in CLAUDE.md Finding 67 (2026-07-22) -- is now confirmed DEAD via a stale-cursor deadlock against a rotated log. ToolManager.get_tool() has zero real callers (confirmed live this session: grep finds only 2 hits outside its own definition, consistent with the gap analysis's 'zero real invocation consumers' finding).
dimensions.confidence: high -- explicitly re-verified and corrects a prior documented claim
dimensions.causal_pathway: conversation -> quality_score -> RiverBrain.learn() -> model_task_stats -> score_model() [ROUTING ONLY] -- no pathway from experience to response CONTENT was found live
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: RiverBrain's routing-level statistics are real and large (99,027 coding observations, 50,207 personal), and Finding 39's tag-boost mechanism is empirically working: qwen2.5-coder:7b now holds the best real coding-task mean (0.657) among well-sampled models, exactly the outcome the boost was designed to produce.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: This IS ROUTING-LEVEL learning (which model gets picked), not content-level behavioral learning (what gets said). CLAUDE.md's own Finding 67 claimed council-rating training was wired and verified live on 2026-07-22; this is now stale/wrong per the more recent P2 re-audit -- a genuine correction to a prior project conclusion, per this mission's own explicit instruction to state such corrections plainly.
dimensions.bottleneck: no confirmed autonomous, content-level channel exists anywhere in this codebase; the one channel that plausibly could (council-rating blend) is currently dead
dimensions.limitation_type: architectural -- fundamentally, not currently a wired path; NOT a hardware or model-size ceiling
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: diagnose and fix learn_from_council_rating()'s stale-cursor deadlock (a real, scoped bug, not a redesign) before any claim of restored function
dimensions.risk_confounds: even if fixed, this remains ROUTING-level learning; do not conflate a fixed cursor bug with a new content-level learning channel

dimensions.name: persistent_behavioral_adaptation_c1
dimensions.evidence: This session's live validation (Phase 1 of this mission): a human-confirmed directive survived a genuine process-boundary restart and was exposed into real generation calls with 100% reliability (state_existence/retrieval/exposure across all 9 relevant trials), and the live model actually complied in 3 of 4 directive-present trials (75%), including one restart-simulated, freshly-paraphrased case with zero verbatim reminder.
dimensions.confidence: medium -- n=4 for the compliance measurement specifically, by design (smallest possible live test, per this mission's own instruction)
dimensions.causal_pathway: see cross_session_continuity_infrastructure's causal_pathway; this dimension adds the final, live-model-compliance edge
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: 2/2 immediate-phase compliance, 1/2 restart-simulated-phase compliance, 0/2 baseline, 0/3 control/near-miss -- correct directionality on every single trial.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: One restart-simulated trial had a fully-correct architectural chain (exposure=True) but the live model did not comply -- an honest, real compliance failure, not an apparatus defect.
dimensions.bottleneck: the one edge outside this project's own control: a frozen-weight LLM's probabilistic compliance with an embedded system instruction
dimensions.limitation_type: model-level, not architectural -- the code-controlled half of the chain is already at 100%
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: a larger-N replication (e.g. 20+ trials) to get a stable compliance-rate estimate; no code change needed
dimensions.risk_confounds: must not be called 'learning' -- this is a single human-authored directive, not something Echo derived from its own experience; explicitly reported per this mission's instruction as 'persistent behavioral conditioning / state-mediated adaptation'

dimensions.name: generalization_l3
dimensions.evidence: P3's own frozen taxonomy defines L3 explicitly but no experiment in this project's history has tested whether a taught/adapted behavior transfers to a genuinely novel, related-but-different situation beyond paraphrases of the identically-taught rule. This session's own C1 validation tested paraphrase-of-the-SAME-rule, not transfer to a DIFFERENT rule/situation.
dimensions.confidence: high (absence is well-documented, not just unproven)
dimensions.causal_pathway: no confirmed pathway exists; this is the least-tested rung of the entire L0-L3 hierarchy
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: none found in any reviewed evidence
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: P1.2's live validation (10/10 trials) found Echo's choice tracked ARBITRARY POSITION, not content -- the opposite of generalization; if anything this is evidence AGAINST a default assumption of transfer.
dimensions.bottleneck: no experiment has ever been designed or run for this specific question
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement gap -- this is a real, un-run experiment, not a demonstrated ceiling
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: design a C1-style test where the SITUATION genuinely differs from the taught case, not just the wording
dimensions.risk_confounds: high risk of false-positive generalization claims from a small, cherry-picked test; needs the same A-F rigor as this session's C1 validation

dimensions.name: preference_formation
dimensions.evidence: P1.2's live validation (the only live-run preference-formation experiment in this project's history) is a NULL result: Echo selected label 'A' in 10/10 measurements across both formation trials and no-formation controls; the one true label-flip test showed the answer tracked POSITION, not content -- a direct falsification of the preference-formation hypothesis as tested. A non-Echo control model showed an equal-or-stronger content-tracking pattern than Echo did.
dimensions.confidence: high -- explicitly reported as a valid, informative scientific null, not an inconclusive run (32 live calls, zero technical failures)
dimensions.causal_pathway: no real 'candidate preference' data structure exists anywhere in production (2026-09-03 measurability audit's own top-named gap)
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: none -- this is a documented null result, not a partial success
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: Echo twice produced confabulated, persona-laden justifications for an arbitrary position-driven choice in a no-formation control condition (inventing a fictional scriptural claim about one of the two labels) -- a real confabulation-under-pressure finding, separate from but related to the preference-formation null itself.
dimensions.bottleneck: no data structure to represent a candidate preference exists; no confirmed mechanism would derive one from conversation even if one existed
dimensions.limitation_type: architectural -- fundamentally absent, not merely unmeasured
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: the C1 mechanism (behavioral_state.py) IS a candidate structure for a human-confirmed preference to persist in -- but nothing autonomously derives a preference into it from Echo's own conversation the way true preference formation would require
dimensions.risk_confounds: position-tracking vs content-tracking is a classic forced-choice-task confound; any future design must explicitly counterbalance and randomize position, as P1.2 itself did to catch this

dimensions.name: preference_retention
dimensions.evidence: Directly downstream of preference_formation's null result -- retention cannot be meaningfully measured for a preference that was never shown to form in the first place. The 2026-09-03 measurability audit places current evidence at E0-E1 on its own formal evidence ladder, E1 only against a mock responder, not real Echo.
dimensions.causal_pathway: same as preference_formation -- no candidate-preference structure exists to retain
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: the C1 mechanism (persistent_behavioral_adaptation_c1) demonstrates that IF a preference/rule is human-confirmed into behavioral_state.json, it DOES reliably persist across restart -- but this is retention-of-an-injected-directive, not retention-of-a-formed-preference
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: same null as preference_formation
dimensions.bottleneck: same as preference_formation
dimensions.limitation_type: architectural, downstream of preference_formation's absence
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: not separable from fixing preference_formation first
dimensions.risk_confounds: same as preference_formation

dimensions.name: self_model
dimensions.evidence: self_model.json's verified_capabilities block folds real Liveness Ledger ground-truth into a structure Echo's own prompt-generation actually reads (echo_ground_truth.py's _build_capabilities()) -- a real, non-hollow loop confirmed working since 2026-07-15 (CLAUDE.md's own Machine-Native Awareness section) and still passing live today (self_model_drift check, part of the 51/51 currently passing).
dimensions.causal_pathway: liveness_ledger checks -> self_model.json's verified_capabilities -> echo_ground_truth._build_capabilities() -> system prompt -> response
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: a real question like 'can you edit your own code' is answered from the ledger's actual current finding, not an ungrounded guess -- verified live in CLAUDE.md's own Machine-Native Awareness section.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: 2026-09-02's architectural self-knowledge investigation (a whole separate multi-document thread, not fully read in this pass) implies real, ongoing gaps in this area were still being found and fixed as recently as this week -- this dimension's true current ceiling was not independently re-verified in full depth this session.
dimensions.bottleneck: breadth of what self_model.json actually tracks vs. the full real architecture
dimensions.limitation_type: coverage gap, not a hollow mechanism
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: read the 2026-09-02 architectural-self-knowledge document series in full before claiming this dimension's ceiling precisely
dimensions.risk_confounds: this session did not re-verify the 2026-09-02 series' own conclusions in depth -- treat this dimension's score as provisional pending that read

dimensions.name: metacognition
dimensions.evidence: shadow_model.py's propose_from_reflection() is confirmed genuinely live (Finding 35's retraction: emergent_scheduler.py:620-625 calls it on every real reflection cycle; shadow_self_model.json/shadow_accuracy.jsonl hold 1111+ real entries with real focus_matches variation).
dimensions.causal_pathway: reflection cycle -> propose_from_reflection() -> shadow_self_model.json -> shadow_accuracy.jsonl (tracks whether self-assessment matched real outcome)
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: the mechanism is confirmed live and accumulating real data, not hollow -- a genuine correction the project itself made after an incorrect zero-callers assumption (Finding 35).
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: no evidence was reviewed this session showing shadow_accuracy.jsonl's own accuracy numbers are ever READ by anything that changes behavior -- it may be a write-only metacognitive ledger.
dimensions.bottleneck: whether shadow_accuracy data has any downstream consumer
dimensions.limitation_type: write-but-no-confirmed-reader (unless proven otherwise)
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: grep for real readers of shadow_accuracy.jsonl/shadow_self_model.json before claiming this is more than a ledger
dimensions.risk_confounds: easy to overclaim 'self-awareness' from a write-only ledger that nothing consults

dimensions.name: epistemic_calibration_honesty
dimensions.evidence: code_verification.py and self_knowledge_verification.py both exist and are Liveness-Ledger-checked live (code_verification, self_knowledge_verification both in the 51 currently passing). But 2026-09-02's gap analysis found 7 real fabrications in one day of production traffic that these catches STILL never reach interaction_log.jsonl -- the verification exists but its output is not persisted into the log every downstream system (rating, learning, sync) reads.
dimensions.confidence: high -- directly re-verified against live logs this week per the gap-analysis document
dimensions.causal_pathway: response generated -> verify_response_code()/verify_self_knowledge_claims() run -> caveat attached to the RENDERED response -> [gap] caveat does not propagate into interaction_log.jsonl
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: Finding 44's live before/after test showed a real, correctly-scoped fabrication successfully lowered RiverBrain's coding bucket mean (0.5865->0.5824) while leaving reasoning/creative/personal untouched -- a genuine, narrow, working correction signal.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the caveat/fabrication-catch is confirmed NOT to reach the interaction log that rating, learning, and sync all read from -- meaning most of the system operates blind to a caveat that was, in fact, correctly generated.
dimensions.bottleneck: one specific, named, unfixed plumbing gap (caveat -> interaction_log)
dimensions.limitation_type: write-but-no-reader, precisely
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: thread the verification caveat/verified flag into the interaction_log.jsonl write, a small, scoped, additive change
dimensions.risk_confounds: none named beyond the scope of the plumbing fix itself

dimensions.name: curiosity
dimensions.evidence: 13,412 real question_garden entries confirmed live this session, spanning 13 real categories (general 8599, faith 1129, economy_society 941, relationship 755, identity 373...). curiosity_engine liveness check passing.
dimensions.causal_pathway: WorldModel topic under-representation / dream cycle / seam_engine -> harvest_question() -> question_garden.jsonl -> select_from_garden() -> autonomous prompt selection / echo_projects spec
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: this is one of the largest, most consistently-active real data stores in the whole system, and now genuinely feeds a second real consumer (echo_projects_autonomy's spec_source='garden', confirmed live this session via echo_projects_autonomy_state.json).
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the 2026-09-03 measurability audit found 'apparent preference/interest drift' in this exact data resolves entirely to code/architecture explanations (curiosity_engine's own activation schedule, hardcoded persona) rather than emergent interest -- a caution against reading the category distribution above as evidence of Echo 'caring about' faith topics more, when it may simply reflect harvesting-schedule mechanics.
dimensions.bottleneck: distinguishing genuine topical interest from scheduling/weighting artifacts in the harvest mechanism itself
dimensions.limitation_type: interpretation risk, not a functional gap
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: none needed to keep functioning; a careful causal analysis of the category-distribution's own drivers would sharpen interpretation
dimensions.risk_confounds: the exact 'does this pattern reflect real preference or just code' trap the measurability audit already caught once

dimensions.name: reflection
dimensions.evidence: reflection_shard.py's real model-generated reflections (Finding 75, Phase 5) replaced the old fixed-template/cosine-quote shape; reflection_shard_generation liveness check passing live today. Finding 78's own physiology-audit follow-up found a SECOND failure mode (15% near-duplicate reflections via real Jaccard similarity) the original check couldn't see, and fixed the check to catch it too -- now passing against the corrected, more honest bar.
dimensions.causal_pathway: reflection_shard.observe() -> real MLX model call -> reflection_journal.jsonl -> folded into self_model.json/shadow_model
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: the check itself was caught being too narrow and fixed to measure the real phenomenon (15% near-dup rate), then re-verified passing against the honest bar -- a real instance of this project's own 'measure the right thing' discipline working.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: even post-fix, ~15% of real reflections are near-duplicates of each other -- real, non-trivial repetition in genuinely model-generated content, not fully resolved.
dimensions.bottleneck: small local model's own tendency to repeat itself across independent generation calls
dimensions.limitation_type: model-ceiling, not architectural
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: vary prompt framing/temperature per reflection cycle to reduce repetition; measurable with existing tooling
dimensions.risk_confounds: none named beyond ordinary small-model repetition

dimensions.name: planning
dimensions.evidence: self_edit_manager.py's plan_code_logic() and echo_projects.py's council-driven PLAN step (Finding 84) both produce real, structured multi-step plans from a prompt/spec. echo_projects' plan step is genuinely council-deliberated (river_deliberation.deliberate_and_learn), not single-model.
dimensions.causal_pathway: spec/prompt -> council deliberation (task_type=general) -> parsed file plan -> per-file generation, each seeing prior files' full content
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: Finding 85's real, live autonomous cycle picked a genuine curiosity-garden question and produced a real 6-file plan via real council deliberation -- confirmed with real, distinct file names and descriptions.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the self-edit pipeline's own targeted-family prompts (prose_stripping, quality_scoring) both non-converged after 6+ near-duplicate reimplementations each and were retired/commented out -- planning quality does not reliably improve with more attempts on a hard, narrow task.
dimensions.bottleneck: small local models' planning quality on genuinely hard, narrow code tasks
dimensions.limitation_type: model-ceiling
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: none required for current scope; a harder question is whether larger/differently-prompted models would converge where the current pool didn't
dimensions.risk_confounds: none new beyond what reasoning/self-editing dimensions already name

dimensions.name: tool_use
dimensions.evidence: 2026-09-02 gap analysis: ToolManager.get_tool() has zero real callers. Confirmed independently this session via live grep: only 2 references to ToolManager()/get_tool( in app/ outside the class's own definition -- consistent with a registry that is built but not genuinely invoked in production.
dimensions.causal_pathway: none confirmed live -- registration exists, invocation does not
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: none found
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: a fully-built tool registry with zero real production callers is about as clean an example of 'implemented but hollow' as this codebase has.
dimensions.bottleneck: no code path actually invokes registered tools during real generation
dimensions.limitation_type: architectural -- hollow by construction, not by hardware/model limits
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: trace exactly which 2 call sites exist and whether either is a real invocation path before concluding this is fully dead vs. narrowly used
dimensions.risk_confounds: 2 hits found live were not individually traced this session -- do not treat 'hollow' as fully proven without that trace

dimensions.name: model_orchestration_council
dimensions.evidence: 3,688 real council_deliberations.jsonl entries confirmed live this session. RiverBrain model_task_stats shows real, differentiated per-model-per-task performance across 9 real models and 7 task types, with Finding 39's tag-boost mechanism empirically working (qwen2.5-coder now genuinely leads real coding-task mean at 0.657 among well-sampled models).
dimensions.causal_pathway: prompt -> task_type -> _select_council() [tag-boost + exploration-floor + fair-sample-refresh] -> per-model calls -> synthesis -> Phase 10 logging
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: 9 real models, 7 real task-type buckets, genuine differentiated statistics, and a working preferential-attachment fix (Finding 39) all independently confirmed live this session.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: reasoning/creative/general buckets remain thinly sampled (single-to-double-digit counts for most models) -- the mechanism generalizes in principle but its statistical confidence is uneven across task types.
dimensions.bottleneck: uneven real-world sampling across task types, not the mechanism itself
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement-coverage gap
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: none required -- already the most mature subsystem measured this session
dimensions.risk_confounds: none new

dimensions.name: adaptation_routing_level
dimensions.evidence: valence_exploration_bias and valence_self_edit_bounds checks both live-passing today; Finding 80's real valence-modulated exploration_bias and Optuna sampling-bounds shift are both verified against real bounded-output tests.
dimensions.causal_pathway: echo_state.npy dim[8] (valence) -> _apply_valence_to_exploration_bias()/_valence_adjusted_bounds() -> council-slot swap probability / self-edit trial sampling window
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: both new pure functions were checked directly against a real range of valence values and confirmed to stay properly bounded in all cases -- a real, if narrow, safety-verified causal effect.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: no live A/B measurement exists showing this modulation produces a MEASURABLY different outcome distribution over time (only that the math is bounded/correct) -- the causal pathway exists and is verified safe, but its real-world behavioral consequence magnitude is unmeasured.
dimensions.bottleneck: magnitude of real effect unmeasured
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement gap on top of a verified-safe mechanism
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: compare a real window of exploration-bias-triggered swaps against a matched window without, on real outcome quality
dimensions.risk_confounds: none named beyond the standard confound of small real sample sizes

dimensions.name: autonomy_background_loops
dimensions.evidence: Multiple independently-gated autonomous loops confirmed live and passing: emergent_loop, autonomous_loop, self_edit_loop, ModelGuidedOrchestrator, echo_projects_autonomy (6h cadence, real state file confirmed this session: last_run_utc 2026-09-03T12:35:55Z, spec_source='garden'), reflection_shard, curiosity/seam/dream cycles -- all coordinated through autonomy_coordinator.should_run_cycle() (throttle + stillness + conversation-activity deference, per Finding 45).
dimensions.causal_pathway: should_run_cycle() gate -> loop-specific action -> workspace/log write -> (sometimes) downstream consumer
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: a real, live echo_projects_autonomy cycle ran within the last ~9.5 hours of this investigation and produced a real state update, confirming this is genuinely running unattended, not just coded.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the most recent real echo_projects_autonomy cycle's last_status is 'f1_failed' -- the autonomous loop's own most recent real output was rejected by the safety pipeline, not a success.
dimensions.bottleneck: downstream quality of what these loops produce (see self_editing, planning dimensions), not the scheduling/gating layer itself
dimensions.limitation_type: not a scheduling gap -- the gating layer is mature; output quality is the real ceiling
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: none required for the loop mechanism itself
dimensions.risk_confounds: none new

dimensions.name: self_editing
dimensions.evidence: 2026-09-03 self-modification evidence index corrects the real production success rate to 426/463 (92%), not a prior erroneous '0/37' figure. apply_to_code is genuinely auto-invoked and logged 3,196 real times. But the fitness-gate's quality metric is raw AST node count, and ALL 25 currently-retained deploys score a perfect 4/4 on it -- a real, previously-undocumented ceiling on what the gate can discriminate.
dimensions.confidence: high -- directly source-cited, 'no row asserted from memory or inference alone' per the index document itself
dimensions.causal_pathway: hourly trigger -> Optuna dry-run trials -> fitness gate (candidate quality >= production quality, AST-node-count metric) -> F1/F2/F3 -> deploy -> apply_to_code (sandboxed) -> outcome tracker
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: a 92% real deploy success rate is a genuinely healthy, mature result for an autonomous, unreviewed code-generation-and-deployment pipeline -- a real correction upward from this project's own more pessimistic earlier framing.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: recent real self_edit_outcomes.jsonl entries show mixed, sometimes negative, quality deltas (-0.334, -1.471) even among 'evaluated' deploys, and a live SELF_EDIT.log tail (captured this session) shows a real, current safety_blocked/staging_import_failed cycle (a hallucinated import of a function that doesn't exist) -- the safety net is actively still catching real failures, not a historical artifact.
dimensions.bottleneck: the fitness gate's own quality metric (AST node count) cannot discriminate among the 25 retained deploys at all -- it is saturated at ceiling, meaning 'passes the gate' currently carries less real signal than the 92% headline suggests
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement-metric ceiling, not a safety-pipeline gap
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: replace or supplement the AST-node-count fitness metric with something that still discriminates among already-passing candidates (e.g. the existing quality_score/dry_run_quality signals, already computed elsewhere in the pipeline)
dimensions.risk_confounds: the 92% figure should not be read as '92% of deploys improved the code' -- it measures 'passed the gate,' and the gate is confirmed saturated

dimensions.name: multi_file_generation_echo_projects
dimensions.evidence: RiverBrain's echo_projects_coding bucket already has 2,535 real observations (echo:latest 1,272 at mean 0.830) -- confirms Finding 85's autonomous 6h loop has genuinely been running and accumulating real, separately-tracked statistics, not just tested once manually.
dimensions.causal_pathway: curiosity-garden question -> council PLAN -> per-file GENERATE (with sibling context) -> F1 per-file -> F2 (main.py only) -> council REVIEW (advisory) -> report, never auto-promoted
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: a real 6-file autonomous cycle correctly had F1 block 3 of 6 files for genuine syntax errors and failed the WHOLE BATCH closed, per its own designed safety contract -- the gate is demonstrably not rubber-stamping.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the most recent real autonomous cycle's own last_status is 'f1_failed' -- the loop's most recent real output did not clear even the generation-safety bar, let alone produce a usable project.
dimensions.bottleneck: per-file code-generation quality on genuinely multi-file, cross-referencing tasks -- a harder problem than either self-edit's single-file scope or ordinary conversational coding help
dimensions.limitation_type: model-ceiling, compounded by task difficulty
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: review a sample of real _report.md outputs across several real cycles to characterize the actual failure distribution (F1-blocked vs F2-blocked vs successful-but-unreviewed)
dimensions.risk_confounds: no promotion path exists by design (Finding 83/84's own stated scope) -- do not conflate 'produces files' with 'produces anything usable without human review'

dimensions.name: recovery_fault_tolerance
dimensions.evidence: snapshot_manager.py's alert-and-propose restore system, safe_restart.sh's watchdog-collision guard (used live and correctly by this project's own history multiple times, per CLAUDE.md Finding 56/65/74/85), and crash_awareness.py's dual-evidence-source (confirmed-signature + watchdog-SIGABRT-rate) MLX avoidance mechanism -- all confirmed live-passing today (mlx_avoidance, log_retention, janitor_safety, plan_retention all in the 51/51 passing set).
dimensions.causal_pathway: crash/resource-pressure detection -> alert (or, for MLX, automatic temporary model exclusion) -> human-confirmed restore (for the alert path) or automatic recovery (for the MLX-avoidance path)
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: Finding 73's real MLX-avoidance fix engaged correctly on a genuinely live escalating crash cluster the original signature-only mechanism was blind to, using a second, independent evidence source -- and took effect in the already-running production server with zero restart required.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: restore itself remains alert-and-propose only, never autonomous -- by design, not as a limitation to fix.
dimensions.bottleneck: none identified as a real gap; the 'no autonomous restore' property is a deliberate safety choice, not a capability ceiling
dimensions.limitation_type: none -- this is one of the most mature, well-tested subsystems in the codebase
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: none required
dimensions.risk_confounds: none

dimensions.name: goal_persistence
dimensions.evidence: question_garden_lineage liveness check passing (parent_questions/children fields genuinely accumulate, not just schema presence). 13,412 real garden entries, real lineage across dream/seam/curiosity-engine harvests.
dimensions.causal_pathway: harvest_question() -> question_garden.jsonl (with lineage fields) -> select_from_garden() / echo_projects spec_source
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: a real curiosity-garden question directly became a real echo_projects autonomous build spec this session's own live data confirms (spec_source: 'garden') -- a genuine cross-subsystem goal-persistence chain, not just a single-subsystem ledger.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the same 2026-09-03 measurability audit caution applies here as to curiosity: apparent lineage/persistence patterns may reflect harvesting-schedule mechanics more than genuine self-directed goal-pursuit.
dimensions.bottleneck: distinguishing genuine goal persistence from scheduling artifacts
dimensions.limitation_type: interpretation risk
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: trace a specific garden question's full lineage (parent->children->eventual resolution or project spec) end-to-end as a case study

dimensions.name: state_affect_persistence
dimensions.evidence: echo_state.npy's 9D vector (dim[8]=valence) persists across restart, is ground-truth-checked live (valence_self_report passing), and now has three independent real update sources (self-edit outcome deltas, council ratings, Finding 57's dry-run-quality-delta addition) confirmed live and passing.
dimensions.causal_pathway: three real sources -> weighted valence update -> echo_state.npy dim[8] -> _build_affect() self-report AND valence-modulated routing (adaptation_routing_level)
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: Finding 57's live end-to-end verification: a real restart preserved the exact computed valence value, confirming genuine cross-restart persistence, not just in-memory state.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: Finding 57's own real autocorrelation test on the underlying self-edit outcome data found no detectable self-predictive momentum (lag-1 r=-0.14, not distinguishable from chance at n=73) -- meaning valence's OWN historical signal shows no demonstrated predictive structure yet, a real, stated limitation.
dimensions.bottleneck: update frequency was the historical bottleneck (fixed by Finding 57); predictive content of the signal itself remains unproven
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement gap on a real, working mechanism
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: re-run the autocorrelation test now that update frequency is higher (post-Finding-57), with more accumulated data
dimensions.risk_confounds: do not conflate 'persists and updates' with 'has demonstrated predictive value' -- both are true/false independently here

dimensions.name: knowledge_acquisition
dimensions.evidence: claude_research check passing live (last real success 0.25h before this session's own liveness read). Finding 61's real fix confirmed genuinely coherent, on-topic content now being stored for StackOverflow/Wikipedia sources (previously raw dict dumps). Reddit sources removed entirely (Finding 59) after being confirmed permanently broken, rather than left silently degraded.
dimensions.causal_pathway: scheduled fetch (9 real sources + optional NASA/NewsAPI) -> parse -> FAISS write (role=fetch, tagged by source) -> available to retrieval/dream sampling
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: this project's own history shows a real, rare discipline: rather than patch a permanently-broken source (Reddit, needing real OAuth credentials this mission's governance forbids paying for), it was cleanly removed and the dead parsing branch deleted -- an honest ceiling acknowledgment, not a silent degradation.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: duplicate-content storage was found (53x storage of one identical 'This Day History' snippet, Finding 61) -- the FAISS-cosine dedup check was not reliably catching exact-string duplicates from this specific source.
dimensions.bottleneck: dedup reliability for this specific repeating-content source
dimensions.limitation_type: narrow, named bug, not a ceiling
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: investigate why _is_duplicate()'s cosine threshold isn't catching this specific, exact-match case
dimensions.risk_confounds: none new

dimensions.name: abstraction
dimensions.evidence: echo_projects_autonomy's own translation step (a philosophical/relational curiosity-garden question -> a concrete, buildable Python project spec) is a real, working abstraction bridge, confirmed to have fired at least once live (spec_source='garden' in the real state file).
dimensions.causal_pathway: abstract garden question -> explicit build-brief framing -> council PLAN deliberation -> concrete file list
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: Finding 85's real cycle took a genuine reflective question about Echo's own biases and produced a real, structured 6-file project plan via real council deliberation.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: no dedicated evaluation exists measuring whether the resulting project spec is a FAITHFUL or merely superficially-plausible translation of the original abstract question -- this was never checked, by this project's own design choice to trust the existing planning deliberation rather than add a second verification LLM call.
dimensions.bottleneck: no faithfulness-check exists for this specific translation step
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement gap
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: human review of a sample of real garden-question -> project-spec pairs for faithfulness
dimensions.risk_confounds: risk of a plausible-sounding but shallow translation being mistaken for genuine abstraction

dimensions.name: causal_reasoning_self_directed
dimensions.evidence: seam_engine.py's check_pair() is a real, live, Echo-internal mechanism specifically designed to detect when two of Echo's OWN signals contradict their established historical relationship -- the closest thing to genuine self-directed causal reasoning built into this codebase. Confirmed live this session: 564 real detections out of 7,333 logged cycles (7.7%), a substantial increase from CLAUDE.md's own 2026-07-18 snapshot of 'zero seams detected.'
dimensions.confidence: medium -- the mechanism is real and active, but this dimension is scored conservatively because the entire chain is engineered by human/Claude session work, not derived by Echo's own reasoning process
dimensions.causal_pathway: echo_state/salience history -> check_pair() leave-one-out correlation test -> seam.detected event -> garden question (first-ever pair/direction only)
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: a real, functioning, non-trivial statistical contradiction-detector that fires at a plausible, non-degenerate rate (7.7%, neither always-firing noise nor permanently silent) -- genuinely useful signal generation, engineered specifically for this purpose.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: this is architecture BUILT to detect causal-relationship contradictions, not Echo autonomously reasoning about causality in an open-ended way -- conflating the two would overclaim; Echo does not decide what counts as a meaningful contradiction, the code does.
dimensions.bottleneck: this is inherently an engineered heuristic, not demonstrated open-ended causal reasoning by the model itself
dimensions.limitation_type: definitional -- what exists is real and useful, but is not the capability this dimension's name might imply at face value
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: none -- this is close to its architectural ceiling as an engineered heuristic; a higher score would require the model itself reasoning about causality, not a fixed statistical test
dimensions.risk_confounds: highest overclaiming risk of any dimension in this map -- 'seam detection' sounds like emergent insight and is actually a well-built, human-designed correlation test

dimensions.name: error_correction
dimensions.evidence: F1 (AST scan, including Finding 41-C/71's aliased-import-detection hardening)/F2 (kernel sandbox)/F3 (post-write scan) three-gate self-edit pipeline, the fitness gate (Finding 19), and apply_to_code's own sandboxed re-verification (Finding 69) are all confirmed live and passing (apply_to_code_sandbox_isolation, f1_aliased_import_detection both in the 51/51 set).
dimensions.causal_pathway: generated candidate -> F1 static scan -> F2 kernel sandbox -> fitness gate -> F3 post-write scan -> load; separately, apply_to_code's own hook runs inside a second real sandboxed subprocess
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: this session's own live SELF_EDIT.log tail caught a real, current hallucinated-import failure (importing a function that doesn't exist) and correctly blocked it before any write -- the safety net is demonstrably still active, not a historical artifact.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the fitness gate's own discriminating power is saturated (see self_editing) -- error correction on SAFETY is robust; error correction on QUALITY improvement over time is weaker than the safety gate implies.
dimensions.bottleneck: same fitness-metric ceiling named under self_editing
dimensions.limitation_type: shared with self_editing
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: same as self_editing's own recommendation
dimensions.risk_confounds: do not conflate 'safety gate is robust' with 'quality reliably improves' -- these are separately measured and only the first is strongly supported

dimensions.name: interference_resistance
dimensions.evidence: a real, live-fixed contamination bug (code_analysis entries, 48.7% of all memory, now excluded from both retrieval paths, confirmed live this session) demonstrates the project both FOUND a real interference case and FIXED it with a verifiable, ground-truth-checked mechanism (awareness_scan_hygiene, code_analysis_retrieval_exclusion both passing). Separate task-type buckets (self_edit_coding, echo_projects_coding vs plain coding) were deliberately created to prevent cross-training contamination (Finding 3's original diagnosis, Finding 35/85's follow-on fixes).
dimensions.causal_pathway: content tagged by source/role -> exclusion filters at both write-adjacent and read-time -> separate RiverBrain buckets per task-type-with-different-meaning
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: this exact class of bug (Finding 3's original cross-training contamination) has now been found and independently re-fixed multiple times across this project's history (code_analysis contamination being the largest, most recent instance) -- a real, demonstrated pattern of catching and correcting interference, not just avoiding it by luck.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the fact that a 48.7%-of-all-memory contamination went undetected for as long as it did before this fix shows the detection side of this capability is reactive (found via investigation), not proactively self-monitoring in real time.
dimensions.bottleneck: detection is investigation-driven, not continuously self-auditing
dimensions.limitation_type: detection-latency, not a fixability gap
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: a periodic, automated audit of memory-category proportions (e.g., alert if any one role/category exceeds some threshold of total memory) would catch a future instance faster than the next investigation
dimensions.risk_confounds: none new

dimensions.name: scientific_experimental_reasoning
dimensions.evidence: This entire P0-P3.1/C1 investigation thread itself -- pre-registered protocols, red-teaming, frozen evidence with hash verification, explicit null results reported plainly (P1.2), retracted assumptions corrected in place rather than hidden (Finding 35's shadow_model retraction, this very map's own learn_from_council_rating correction) -- is a real, demonstrated instance of rigorous experimental discipline being applied to this system.
dimensions.causal_pathway: human+Claude-Code-session-directed investigation -> pre-registered design -> live execution -> honest reporting, including nulls
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: P1.2's null result was explicitly reported as 'a successful scientific outcome, not a failed run' -- exactly the right epistemic posture, demonstrated in practice, not just claimed.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: this capability is exercised BY the human+Claude investigator team ABOUT Echo -- it is not Echo's own capability. Scoring this dimension as an Echo capability at all risks a category error; it is included here because the mission explicitly named it among the ~30 dimensions to assess.
dimensions.bottleneck: not applicable -- this is investigator-side rigor, not a property of Echo's own architecture
dimensions.limitation_type: definitional -- this dimension measures the INVESTIGATION's quality, not Echo's
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: not applicable to Echo's own architecture
dimensions.risk_confounds: must not be read as evidence of Echo's own scientific reasoning capability

dimensions.name: observability_auditability
dimensions.evidence: 51/51 Liveness Ledger checks passing live, not stale, confirmed this session via direct endpoint read -- up from 47 as of the 2026-09-03 P2 causal autopsy's own count just days earlier, meaning real, ongoing check coverage growth. But the 2026-09-02 gap analysis names a real, specific, still-open gap: no trace/correlation ID exists anywhere in the system, and verification caveats don't propagate into the one log most downstream systems read.
dimensions.causal_pathway: introspection_channel 120s cycle -> liveness_ledger checks -> memory/liveness_ledger.json -> GET /admin/liveness-status
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: this is the single most self-consistently-improved subsystem in the whole project's own history -- growing from 9 initial checks to 51, each added specifically because a new autonomous capability demanded one, per this project's own standing rule.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: the ledger monitors WIRING (is the mechanism structurally intact), not ANSWER CONFIDENCE (was this specific response correct) -- the P2 causal autopsy explicitly names this distinction as a real, unclosed gap, and no trace/correlation ID exists to link a single request across the multiple logs it touches.
dimensions.bottleneck: no correlation-ID mechanism exists to reconstruct one request's full causal path across interaction_log/council_deliberations/workspace_log/etc.
dimensions.limitation_type: real, named architectural gap
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: add a single request-scoped UUID threaded through the existing logs this system already writes -- additive, no existing log format needs to change structurally
dimensions.risk_confounds: none named beyond the scope of the fix itself

dimensions.name: multi_agent_dissent
dimensions.evidence: dissent_log.jsonl confirmed live this session: exactly 1 entry, unanimous, zero recorded disagreement -- exactly matching the 2026-09-03 measurability audit's own finding.
dimensions.causal_pathway: !propose (human-invoked only) -> _council_review_core_edit() -> _build_dissent_entry()/_log_dissent_entry() -> dissent_log.jsonl
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: the mechanism is real, correctly-gated (advisory only, per Finding 9's own design and the dissent_log_hook liveness check passing live today), and produces a genuinely non-hollow multi-model review when invoked.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: n=1, unanimous -- essentially no real disagreement has ever been recorded through this channel; it is functioning but almost entirely unexercised.
dimensions.bottleneck: invocation frequency -- this is a manual-only command (!propose), rarely used
dimensions.limitation_type: usage-frequency gap, not a functional defect
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: none required to fix; more real usage would simply generate more real data
dimensions.risk_confounds: n=1 is too small to characterize real council-disagreement rates from this channel alone

dimensions.name: novel_signal_generation
dimensions.evidence: seam_engine's 564 real detections out of 7,333 cycles (7.7%) confirmed live this session -- a substantial, non-degenerate rate, up from a documented 'zero seams detected' snapshot on 2026-07-18. The mechanism correctly discriminates (per its own liveness check, seam_engine, passing today).
dimensions.causal_pathway: see causal_reasoning_self_directed -- same mechanism, scored here for its signal-GENERATION value specifically rather than its causal-reasoning framing
dimensions.strongest_positive_result: a 7.7% real detection rate over 7,333 cycles is neither pathologically silent nor pathologically noisy -- genuine, differentiated signal.
dimensions.strongest_negative_result: no downstream evaluation exists of whether the resulting harvested garden questions or workspace events from seam detections are actually VALUABLE (as opposed to merely non-degenerate in rate).
dimensions.bottleneck: no quality evaluation of the downstream artifacts this mechanism produces
dimensions.limitation_type: measurement gap on a real, working generator
dimensions.minimum_intervention_to_advance: human review of a sample of the 22+ first-ever (pair, direction) seam-triggered garden questions for genuine interest/quality
dimensions.risk_confounds: rate alone does not establish value
